waypoints.name: SR 20 pullout (1.5 mi W of pass)
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 to the long pullout on the north side of the highway about a mile and a half west of Washington Pass, at roughly 5,100 ft. The climbers' track leaves the east end of that pullout — it starts on the west side of a clump of trees near the eastern end and is usually cairned, but it takes some hunting the first time and is easy to walk past. It is genuinely hard to find in the dark, so spend a minute at the east end before committing to a pre-dawn start.
